text: 株式会社デジアラホールディングス (DIGITAL ALLIANCE Holdings CO.,LTD) is a Kobe holding company founded in April 2000 managing group companies in online retail of housing/exterior equipment and exterior works; its company outline names 有本哲也 (Tetsuya Arimoto) as representative director.
short: Digiara Holdings (Digital Alliance Holdings) is a private Kobe company, representative director Tetsuya Arimoto.
